comment: Boundary probes for unknown-cause diagnosis in new or existing code, including precedence over TDD and performance work.

queries.query: Use $systematic-debugging to determine why this worker sometimes stops consuming messages.
The service crashes only on one production host after several hours. We do not know the cause; diagnose it.
A test passes locally but fails about one run in twenty in CI. Isolate what actually causes the failure before changing the code.
The caching layer I just added passes its own tests, but two unrelated integration tests started failing after it went in and I can't see why.
Validation trims after checking emptiness. Add a regression test for blank input, then move trimming before the guard.
Profile this known CPU-heavy import path and reduce median runtime by 20% on the supplied corpus.
Yesterday's deployment doubled p99 latency, but we do not know why. Find the cause, then validate any optimization against the prior baseline.
